note: literal 'والله الدنيا حلوة' is an oath-flavored 'I swear, life is sweet' — flattened the oath (no natural Russian equivalent in casual speech) and used a colloquial tag 'чё уж там' to keep the same relaxed, slightly boastful register instead
kept it casual/slangy ('го' + 'дернем') to match the friend-to-friend invitation tone rather than a neutral 'давай выпьем чаю'
